versions.changelog:
- Updated references: Skill now states all Google SEO Starter Guide best practices are embedded; no longer instructs to consult an external reference file.
- Simplified audit and writing instructions by removing explicit references to external documents.
- Clarified approach for answering questions—removed instruction to reference the Google guide.
- No functional changes to modes or advice flow; guidance and tone remain user-friendly and practical.
- The description and myth-busting sections are unchanged.

- Initial release of the Google SEO Assistant skill, grounded in Google's official SEO Starter Guide.
- Supports three core modes: SEO audit, SEO content writing, and answering SEO questions in plain English.
- Provides clear, actionable recommendations and explanations focused on real business owners, not experts.
- Proactively corrects common SEO myths and misconceptions.
- Includes specific audit checklist and writing guidelines to improve website visibility on Google.
